user_direction: The playable prototype is reference only and may contain bugs. Formal engine implementation need not reproduce it exactly.
acceptance_boundary: Measured model geometry and asset identity are evidence. Prototype layouts, tuning, cameras, rules, materials and UI flows remain references pending TA/product/art confirmation.

coordinates.world: Three.js/glTF: +X table long axis, +Y up, +Z table short axis; right-handed
coordinates.physics2d_to_runtime3d: Ball {x,y} -> mesh [x, BALL_RADIUS, y]; collider/pocket {x,y} -> [x, 0, y]
coordinates.native_engine_conversion: Confirm importer handedness, units and axis conversion with TA; do not apply both an importer conversion and a second manual conversion.

transforms.canonical_assets: Normalized table.glb and ball GLBs are metre-scale assets, not pre-enlarged.
transforms.anti_double_scaling: Either use the canonical coordinates under the 1.2 playfield root or use displayed/world coordinates under identity; never do both.

measured_table.note: Geometry measurements are provided to support fitting colliders to the actual table. Final collision model and pocket behavior require TA validation.

existing_engine_reference_parameters.pocket_trigger_reference: Prototype uses passage through the radius-inset measured throat; captureRadius metadata is geometric advisory data, not the current full trigger algorithm.
existing_engine_reference_parameters.free_ball_region_reference: Actual _canPlace() checks table limits, sphere-radius clearance to every measured rail, pocket openings and remaining balls; there is no authored placement-zone mesh.
